name: Unworthy Champion
summary: Clugfist in Bolder'ok wants you to recover Skullbasher from Klunk. He no longer considers Klunk worthy of the weapon.

sections.title: Clugfist's Demand
sections.body: Clugfist sends you after Klunk, who left Bolder'ok and took ogres with him to a cave east of the water. He wants his weapon back and calls Klunk weak. Skullbasher is the mark of a champion in Clugfist's eyes, and he means to choose another.

faq.answer: Klunk was once Clugfist's champion, but Clugfist now calls him weak.
Clugfist is the ogre who gave Klunk a mighty weapon and now wants it back.
Clugfist says Skullbasher belongs to him and calls Klunk unworthy of it.
Klunk left Bolder'ok with ogres and went to a cave east of the water.
Skullbasher is the mighty weapon Clugfist gave Klunk.

faq.q: What does Clugfist plan to do next?
faq.answer: Clugfist says he will choose a new champion someday.
